description: Experiential luxury retail, cosmetics pop-up activations, visitor footfall tracking, inventory sell-through rate, lease duration, and luxury brand performance.

kpi_templates.name: Total Pop-Up Gross Revenue
kpi_templates.description: Total gross revenue generated across all luxury pop-up activations (Price × Units Sold).
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({unit_price} * {units_sold}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Total Units Sold
kpi_templates.description: Total luxury cosmetics units sold across all pop-up retail events.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST(SUM({units_sold}) AS BIGINT) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Average Daily Footfall
kpi_templates.description: Mean daily pedestrian visitor footfall per pop-up activation location.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG({footfall}) AS DOUBLE), 1) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Average Sell-Through Rate
kpi_templates.description: Average inventory sell-through rate across retail activations.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG({sell_through}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Total Pop-Up Activations
kpi_templates.description: Total count of unique luxury pop-up retail activations.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT {event_id}) AS BIGINT) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Active Luxury Houses
kpi_templates.description: Total unique luxury brands running pop-up activations.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT {brand}) AS BIGINT) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Average Product Price
kpi_templates.description: Average unit retail price of luxury cosmetic SKUs.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG({unit_price}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Average Lease Duration
kpi_templates.description: Average pop-up lease duration in days across global locations.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG({lease_length}) AS DOUBLE), 1) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Average Revenue per Activation
kpi_templates.description: Average gross sales revenue generated per individual pop-up activation.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({unit_price} * {units_sold}) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {event_id}), 0) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

dimensional_templates.description: Revenue and units breakdown by luxury brand maison.
dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST({brand} AS VARCHAR) AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({unit_price} * {units_sold}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS revenue FROM df WHERE {brand} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {brand} ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

dimensional_templates.description: Revenue breakdown across global geographic regions.
dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST({region} AS VARCHAR) AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({unit_price} * {units_sold}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS revenue FROM df WHERE {region} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {region} ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 15
